headlines.author: Rohan Goswami and Shelby Talcott
headlines.event_summary_zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在英伟达董事会会议上呼吁黄仁勋的回归，而就在该公司恢复被罢免的首席执行官的几小时前。英伟达董事会周一恢复了黄仁勋的职务，称该公司已得到“美国高层的保证”
headlines.event_summary_en:
US President Donald Trump had dialed into Nvidia’s board meeting to argue for Jensen Huang’s return, hours before the company reinstated the ousted CEO, according to people familiar with the matter.

Nvidia’s board on Monday reinstated Huang, saying the company had received assurances from “senior levels of the United States government” that he posed no national security risk after carrying on an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

headlines.title_en: Z.ai follows OpenAI into loop transformer territory with its new 750B flagship model
headlines.author: Jonathan Kemper
headlines.event_summary_zh: Z.ai 正在将其旗舰模型转向循环架构，该架构的某些层运行两次。该公司希望通过 GLM-5.4 标志着“通用编码”的开始，其中代码还可以生成视频、游戏和 CAD 模型。继 OpenAI 之后，Z.ai 推出了 GLM-5.4，这是其第一个基于环形变压器构建的大型模型
headlines.event_summary_en:
Z.ai is moving its flagship model to a loop architecture that runs some of its layers twice. With GLM-5.4, the company wants to mark the start of "Generalized Coding,"where code also generates videos, games, and CAD models.

celebrity.author: Yann LeCun
celebrity.author_role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
celebrity.quote_zh:
@RajeswarSai LLM 后期培训非常昂贵，正是因为 RL 的样本效率太低了。

在现实世界中，也就是我的蛋糕幻灯片的主题，强化学习只能发挥次要作用，正是因为它的样本效率低下。
celebrity.quote_en:
@RajeswarSai LLM post-training is so insanely expensive precisely because RL is so damn sample inefficient.

In the real world, which was the subject of my cake slide, RL can only play a minor role precisely because of its sample inefficiency.
